strings.en: Engaging!
I'll play it safe!
First strike's mine!
You left an opening!
At this range!
You'll be my trophy!
I'll earn distinction here!
On the pride of the Fury!
I'll give my all for the Fury!
Fall into the darkness of Voda!
Know the power of us, the Fury!
Here I come, Earthling!
Vanish into the darkness of Voda!
Lord Al-Van... if you would be our enemy...!
My opponent is a knight... How do I fight this...!
I'll take back the Throne Unit!
It may be a Throne Unit,/　but with an Earthling piloting it...!
You'll be giving back the Granteed!
Even if my opponent is/　the Granteed Dracodeus...!
I'll take back the Throne Unit and Her Highness!
I'll hold off the Granteed Dracodeus!
The counterfeit will be destroyed!
The counterfeit's existence will not be tolerated!
Vanish, Bellzelute!
Whatever form it takes,/　a counterfeit is still a counterfeit!
I'll destroy you so thoroughly you can't regenerate!
Putting on armor won't help you!
Something that big... if I hit its blind spot...!
Big or not, it's still just a counterfeit!
That thing's like a walking armory...!
No matter how many weapons the counterfeit carries!
Hmph, whatever its form,/　a counterfeit is a counterfeit!
Damn you, Vaula! Vanish!
I will strike down the calamity/　that came from the Gate of Voda!
The Steel Dragons' mothership!
If I can just sink their mothership...!
A Grungust type... That's a big one!
Target, Grungust type!
It may be a refitted old model,/　but with a body that size!
An old Grungust type is nothing!
You fake Hückebein!
The Hückebein is fated to vanish anyway!
Riding a gun platform won't help you!
Shooting down the latest model will earn me glory!
I won't let you Combine!
The R Series aren't much of a threat/　before they combine!
Concentrate fire on the SRX!
I'll tear you to pieces, SRX!
If I know it's going to charge...!
Gambler's tactics won't work on us!
I'll strike before it gets distance!
Whatever its maneuvers, I'll catch it!
What can a defective unit do?!
It may be agile, but if I narrow down where to aim!
No matter how fast it is, I'll catch it!
A Gespenst type is no enemy of mine!
You'd face us with an old model?
No matter how an old machine changes its gear!
If I beat the Double G, my skills will be recognized...!
Target, Double G!
As long as I stay out of that great sword's reach...!
It's nothing like the divine dragon Basileus!
A Choukijin... A worthy opponent!
Cybuster.../　An opponent I can't let my guard down against!
Its wide-area weapon is dangerous!
I never thought I'd have to fight that thing...!
A mighty foe, but it would bring unmatched glory!
If Larseilam won't work on it,/　it has to be shot down first!
Size alone doesn't decide a fight!
Even with a difference in mass, there's a way to fight!
No matter how thick the armor!
Even without data, I can tell it's a close-combat type!
Before the new model's barrage hits me!
Damn that new model, it's been powered up!
Adding wings won't help you!
Damn you, Jevilun! Vanish!
Even if it's a large Jevilun!
I won't let you go home like that!
Now it's my turn!
You're still in my range!
I put myself on the line to lure you in, so...!
Don't think you can withdraw so easily!
I've been waiting for this moment!
Even if I'm on the back foot!
I can't back down like this!
This is only the beginning!
I-I've failed!!
Is this... the end...!!
M-My life... I don't regret...!!
Gwaaah!
The darkness of Voda! Uwoaaah!!
Even if I fall, the Fury will...!!
N-Not here!!
My life, for the imperial family!!
Gwaaah!!
My life, for the Fury...!!
S-So this... is the darkness of Voda...!!
A-Any more damage would be bad...!
I'm nearing my limit...!
To be driven this far...!
I-I have to regroup!
Grrr! A direct hit?!
It's responding slowly! At this rate...!
Ngh! If only my unit could move...!
I'll fulfill my duty as a Squire no matter what!
Bad, the unit's center of gravity is off!
D-Damn you, Earthlings!
As if I could accept that we're inferior!
Damn it! I can't end this after being toyed with!
I'm prepared to offer my life to the imperial family!
I-I can't stop Lord Al-Van!
I-Is Lord Al-Van serious...?!
A-At this rate, retaking the Throne Unit/　is out of the question...!
How can they handle the Throne Unit so well...?!
W-We must stop the Throne Unit at all costs!
A-Am I to be defeated by the Throne Unit,/　the guardian deity of the Fury?!
To experience the Throne Unit's power firsthand...!
T-To be beaten this badly by an experimental unit!
B-By such a feeble machine!
Grr! I can't stop the Bellzelute!
Earthlings mastering our technology...!
S-So it's no wonder it helped/　seal the Vaula away...!
That kind of agility at that size.../　You've got to be kidding!
Ngh! Its firepower and size are no joke!
D-Damn you, Vaula!
I-I can't stop the Grungust!!
That's supposed to be a dead copy of the Hückebein!!
I-It looks like a Personal Trooper,/　but on the inside...!!
That much power without even combining...!
A-As I thought, the SRX's power/　is not to be underestimated!!
Ugh! I can't let it shoot me through!
Damn you, Einst!!
Wasn't that thing supposed to be defective?!
To be pushed this far by a mere Gespenst...!!
I-If I take another hit from that great sword...!
I-I can't escape its aim!
The difference in size can't be helped, but...!
Grrr! Overwhelmed by sheer power?!
With a body that big,/　there has to be an opening somewhere!
W-What's with that speed?!!
S-So this is the power of a Choukijin...!
Ngh! I can't stop the Cybuster!!
G-Granzon... What power...!!
Like I'd let a Jevilun beat me!
Grr, I'm being pushed back?!
Blast it, don't get cocky!
Ngh! It's just as powerful as the intel said!
It hit me in a bad spot...!
This much is still within expectations!
Don't get cocky, Earthlings!
I won't fall to this!
Ugh! Was I too slow to react?!
Don't underestimate our resolve!
As I thought, that lot can't be taken lightly...!
They can fight us, the Fury, this well...!
My movements were read?!
Even if I'm no match for Lord Al-Van,/　I can't retreat here!
Ngh! A-As expected of a knight... Too strong!
Ngh! As expected of a Throne Unit...!
Are they drawing out the Throne Unit's power?!
Against a Throne Unit, how long can I hold out...?!
Don't get cocky, counterfeit!
Damn that Bellzelute, I won't let it resist any longer!
Grr! Wasn't it just more armor?!
Ngh! That thing has more firepower than before!
Grr! So it really did/　go toe to toe with the Vaula...!
With that firepower, facing it head-on is a bad idea...!
For a counterfeit to have this much power...!
I can't let this turn into a contest of strength!
I can't let the Vaula go unchecked!
Blast it, damn that Grungust!
Ugh! It moves well for something that big!
I-I can't take that power head-on!
As I thought, it doesn't have/　the Hückebein Mk-III's power!
Blast you, I'll knock you off that gun platform!
Th-That power.../　Is that thing really a Hückebein?!
I have to finish it before it combines...!
You'll pay for that, SRX!
Not good, I have to get some distance from it!
Damn you, Einst! You'll pay for that!
It handles that dubious power source so well...!
I won't let you cut me in two!
Such precise aim from that giant body...!
Those kicks are a nuisance!
Th-Their large units are not to be underestimated!
Damn you, Choukijin, you'll pay for that!
Ngh! I can't shake off the Cybuster!
Bad! The Granzon has me in its sights!
Damn you, Jevilun! You'll pay for that!
Ngh, it hit me!
It only grazed me!
It read my evasive maneuvers?!
No impact on combat!
That didn't even keep me in check!
Tch, that was careless!
An attack like that is nothing!
It's latched onto me!
It's only a scratch, but I can't let my guard down...!
Minor damage... No problem!
You mean to face the Fury with that?
I was too slow to evade...!
Ngh! There's no mercy on the battlefield...!
I never expected to come out unscathed/　against a knight's unit!
Is moving the Throne Unit all you can manage?!
The Throne Unit's power should be greater than this...!
With this, I can hold off/　the Granteed Dracodeus...!
Looks like you still haven't mastered/　the sword of the imperial family!
You'd oppose us with a counterfeit?!
As feeble as you look, Bellzelute!
No matter how much they modify the Bellzelute!
That counterfeit is faster than before...!
A counterfeit made by that lot/　is only this good after all!
Is all that grand equipment just for show?!
If this is all it can do, even the Vaula...!
Grungust... I don't see it as much of a threat.
A large unit's attacks can simply be deflected!
That attack doesn't suit its size!
Hmph, all bark and no bite!
Looks like you're no match for the Hückebein!
The latest model, and this is all?!
Did you think you could face us without combining?!
Even combined, that's all you've got?!
Hmph, charging in is all you can do!
Looks like the only special thing about it is its looks.
Not bad for a cobbled-together machine...!
What a letdown, new model!
Upgraded or not, if this is all it can do!
Hmph, a mere Gespenst!
It seems you're nowhere near/　a knight's swordsmanship...!
I heard to watch out for that line of machines.../　but it's nothing special.
Is speed your only strength, Cybuster?
The Granzon's power should be greater than this...!
The Jevilun's latched onto me?!
Your aim is sloppy!
That's nothing!
I don't intend to end my days as a Squire!
You won't hit me!
You won't hit me, Jevilun!
Once I read its movements, it's nothing!
It dodged?!
Don't underestimate the Fury!
Sloppy aim!
That won't work!
Useless!
No need to dodge!
Is that all?!
So what?!
I can't counterattack?!
Did I fall into the enemy's trap...?!
Is retreat my only option?!
Ngh, at this rate...!
Bad, have I used up too much?!
I have no choice but to fall back...!
I took the wrong position...!
To lose sight of the enemy...!
Where did that thing disappear to?!
Tch, it hid well!
It got out of my range?!
I'll let you go for now!
Moving in to support!
I'll cover the rear!
I'm not done yet!
It's not over yet!
Lord Al-Van, I'll support you!
Lady Fu-Ruu, leave the rest to me!
Lord Jua-Mu, I'll support you!
Chief Agent, sir, I'll support you!
Knight Commander, sir, allow me to support you!
I'll use my unit as a shield!
I won't let you!
I'll be the shield!
I won't let you hit your mark!
Lord Al-Van, please fall back!
Leave this to me, Lady Fu-Ruu!
Lord Jua-Mu, please fall back!
Chief Agent, sir, leave this to me!
I'll protect the Knight Commander!
Going in again!
No mercy!
You can't withstand this!
A perfect target!
Now!
Hit!
Take this!
Shatter!
I'll crush you!
Take this!
I'll hit you!
You're not getting away!
With these claws!
Got you!
I'll tear you apart!
Haaaah!
Take this!
You're mine!
Haaah!
Pierce!
I won't miss!
There!
Go down!
Target locked!
Take this!
Maximum output!
Go!
Aiming... correcting error!
Now!
